scrapedNews.title: SBP Monetary Policy Committee Signals Further 150bps Key Policy Rate Easing as CPI Drops to 6.9%
scrapedNews.summary: State Bank of Pakistan MPC meeting minutes indicate room for aggressive rate normalization following single-digit inflation prints, lowering sovereign borrowing costs and sparking large-cap equity reallocation.

scrapedNews.title: ECC Approves Rs 245 Billion Circular Debt Settlement Tranche for E&P and Power Producers
scrapedNews.summary: Economic Coordination Committee finalizes targeted sovereign cash release to state-owned energy exploration giants OGDC and PPL, alongside key IPP dividend clearances for Hub Power Company (HUBC).

scrapedNews.title: Pakistan Tech Exports Breach $3.2B Annual Run-Rate; Systems Limited Expands Gulf Enterprise Deals
scrapedNews.summary: Ministry of IT reports 34% year-on-year surge in tech service remittances; leading software exporters benefit from dollar earnings hedging and high-margin cloud migration contracts.

scrapedNews.title: IMF Mission Expresses Satisfaction Over Primary Surplus and Tax Revenue Mobilization Targets
scrapedNews.summary: IMF review concludes first quarter structural benchmarks are met with substantial foreign exchange reserve accretion at SBP, dampening external debt default swaps to 3-year lows.

scrapedNews.title: Refinery Policy 2024 Upgrades: ATRL and PRL Secure Financial Closures for Euro-V Expansion
scrapedNews.summary: Attock Refinery and Pakistan Refinery formally enter the project execution phase under the Brownfield Refinery Policy, unlocking tariff protection and substantial duty exemptions.
